alerts.name: go_gc_pause_high
alerts.title: Go Gc Pause High
alerts.description: Warning: Go GC average pause time exceeds 100ms. Tune heap size or investigate memory allocation patterns.

alerts.name: go_gc_rate_high
alerts.title: Go Gc Rate High
alerts.description: Warning: Go GC frequency exceeds 10 collections/min. Application is under memory pressure. Increase heap size or reduce allocations.

alerts.name: cert_already_expired
alerts.title: Cert Already Expired
alerts.description: Critical: cert-manager certificate has already expired. Services using this certificate will fail TLS validation. Renew immediately.

alerts.name: cert_challenge_failed
alerts.title: Cert Challenge Failed
alerts.description: Warning: cert-manager ACME challenge has errored. Certificate renewal will fail. Check DNS records, HTTP-01 solver ingress, or Let's Encrypt rate limits.

alerts.name: cert_expiry_critical_7d
alerts.title: Cert Expiry Critical 7d
alerts.description: Critical: cert-manager certificate expires in less than 7 days. Cert-manager should renew automatically — check for ACME challenge failures or DNS issues.

alerts.name: cert_expiry_warning_30d
alerts.title: Cert Expiry Warning 30d
alerts.description: Warning: cert-manager certificate expires within 30 days. Monitor renewal progress. If cert-manager is healthy it will renew at 2/3 of lifetime.

alerts.name: apiserver_high_latency
alerts.title: Apiserver High Latency
alerts.description: Warning: API server P99 request latency exceeds 1 second. Investigate API server load and etcd performance.

alerts.name: certificate_expiry_warning
alerts.title: Certificate Expiry Warning
alerts.description: Warning: One or more API server client certificates expire within 30 days. Plan certificate rotation immediately.

alerts.name: cluster_cpu_capacity_high
alerts.title: Cluster Cpu Capacity High
alerts.description: Warning: Cluster-wide CPU requests exceed 80% of allocatable. Uses clamp_max(100) to guard against telemetry unit mismatches (some clusters report CPU in millicores vs cores).

alerts.name: cluster_memory_capacity_high
alerts.title: Cluster Memory Capacity High
alerts.description: Warning: Cluster-wide memory requests exceed 80% of allocatable. Uses clamp_max(100) to guard against telemetry unit mismatches.

alerts.name: cluster_pod_count_high
alerts.title: Cluster Pod Count High
alerts.description: Warning: Cluster pod count exceeds 90% of max pod capacity. Review pod density and plan scaling.

alerts.name: container_cpu_limit_high
alerts.title: Container Cpu Limit High
alerts.description: Warning: Pod CPU usage exceeds 80% of its configured limit. Risk of throttling. Review CPU limits or optimize the application.

alerts.name: container_memory_near_limit
alerts.title: Container Memory Near Limit
alerts.description: Warning: Pod memory usage exceeds 90% of its configured limit. Risk of OOMKill. Increase memory limit or investigate leak.

alerts.name: container_not_ready
alerts.title: Container Not Ready
alerts.description: Warning: Container has been failing readiness probe for >5 minutes. Excludes pods in Succeeded phase (completed Jobs/CronJobs always show ready=0).

alerts.name: container_restarted
alerts.title: Container Restarted
alerts.description: Info: Container has restarted. Monitor for pattern; investigate if restarts are frequent.

alerts.name: admission_webhook_failures_high
alerts.title: Admission Webhook Failures High
alerts.description: Warning: Admission webhook rejection rate exceeds 0.5/s. Check webhook endpoint health and configuration.

alerts.name: apiserver_error_rate_high
alerts.title: Apiserver Error Rate High
alerts.description: Critical: API server 5xx error rate exceeds 1/s. Investigate API server health and etcd performance.

alerts.name: apiserver_inflight_requests_high
alerts.title: Apiserver Inflight Requests High
alerts.description: Warning: API server has >400 in-flight requests. Risk of request queue overflow and latency spikes.

alerts.name: controller_queue_processing_slow
alerts.title: Controller Queue Processing Slow
alerts.description: Warning: Work queue P99 processing wait time exceeds 1 second. Controller is overloaded or reconciliation is blocked.

alerts.name: controller_reconcile_errors_high
alerts.title: Controller Reconcile Errors High
alerts.description: Warning: Controller Manager reconcile error rate exceeds 0.1/s. Check controller logs for reconciliation failures.

alerts.name: controller_workqueue_depth_high
alerts.title: Controller Workqueue Depth High
alerts.description: Warning: Controller Manager work queue depth exceeds 50. Controller is falling behind on reconciliation.

alerts.name: azure_maintenance_scheduled_events
alerts.title: Azure Maintenance Scheduled Events
alerts.description: Warning: Azure scheduled VM maintenance event detected (Freeze/Preempt/Terminate/Redeploy). Node will be unavailable soon. Review workload disruption budget.

alerts.name: azure_storage_provisioning_failed_events
alerts.title: Azure Storage Provisioning Failed Events
alerts.description: Warning: Azure disk/storage provisioning failures detected. PVCs may be stuck in Pending. Check Azure storage backend and quota.

alerts.name: coredns_unreachable_events
alerts.title: Coredns Unreachable Events
alerts.description: Critical: CoreDNS is unreachable. All in-cluster DNS resolution is failing. Check CoreDNS pods and kube-dns service immediately.

alerts.name: high_warning_event_rate
alerts.title: High Warning Event Rate
alerts.description: Warning: >100 Kubernetes warning events in 5 minutes. Cluster may be unstable. Investigate the source.

alerts.name: hpa_metric_unavailable_events
alerts.title: Hpa Metric Unavailable Events
alerts.description: Warning: HPA cannot retrieve resource metrics for autoscaling decisions. Scaling is blind. Check metrics-server and HPA configuration.

alerts.name: image_pull_errors_events
alerts.title: Image Pull Errors Events
alerts.description: Warning: >3 image pull error events in 10 minutes. Verify image registry access and credentials.

alerts.name: image_pull_secret_missing_events
alerts.title: Image Pull Secret Missing Events
alerts.description: Warning: Pods cannot retrieve image pull secret. Images will fail to pull. Check secret existence, name, and namespace.

alerts.name: network_not_ready_events
alerts.title: Network Not Ready Events
alerts.description: Warning: CNI network plugin not ready on node. New pods cannot be scheduled. Check CNI DaemonSet and plugin logs.

alerts.name: node_condition_change_events
alerts.title: Node Condition Change Events
alerts.description: Warning: Node condition change events detected (NotReady/DiskPressure/MemoryPressure). Investigate node health.

alerts.name: node_drain_failed_events
alerts.title: Node Drain Failed Events
alerts.description: Warning: Node drain is failing. Cluster upgrades or maintenance may be stalled. Check PodDisruptionBudgets and stuck pods.

alerts.name: node_shutdown_events
alerts.title: Node Shutdown Events
alerts.description: Critical: Multiple node shutdown events detected (3+ events per period). Groups by cluster to avoid 1 node shutdown generating 20+ separate alerts from DaemonSet pod terminations.

alerts.name: oom_killing_events
alerts.title: Oom Killing Events
alerts.description: Critical: Node OOM killer is actively terminating processes (node-level event). Check which pods on the node are consuming excessive memory.

alerts.name: pod_sandbox_failed_events
alerts.title: Pod Sandbox Failed Events
alerts.description: Warning: Pod network sandbox creation failing. CNI plugin or container runtime issues. Pods will not start networking.

alerts.name: pod_scheduling_failures_events
alerts.title: Pod Scheduling Failures Events
alerts.description: Warning: >30 pod scheduling failure events in 5 minutes. Review resource requests and cluster capacity. Excludes arc-runners-* and devzero-system (on-demand autoscaling namespaces where transient FailedScheduling bursts are expected; stuck pods there are still caught by pod_pending_too_long). Threshold accounts for duplicate event ingestion (~5-10x per event).

alerts.name: pod_unhealthy_probe_events
alerts.title: Pod Unhealthy Probe Events
alerts.description: Warning: >10 readiness or liveness probe failure events in 5 minutes. Pods are failing health checks. Check application health and probe configuration.

alerts.name: volume_mount_failures_events
alerts.title: Volume Mount Failures Events
alerts.description: Critical: Volume mount failure events detected. Check PVC binding and storage backend health.

alerts.name: dns_high_latency
alerts.title: Dns High Latency
alerts.description: Warning: CoreDNS P99 request latency exceeds 500ms. Investigate CoreDNS pod health and upstream DNS servers.

alerts.name: dns_resolution_failures_high
alerts.title: Dns Resolution Failures High
alerts.description: Warning: CoreDNS error response rate exceeds 10/s. Check CoreDNS pods and upstream DNS configuration.

alerts.name: node_network_errors_high
alerts.title: Node Network Errors High
alerts.description: Warning: Node network error rate exceeds 10/s. Investigate network configuration and CNI plugin.

alerts.name: service_no_ready_endpoints
alerts.title: Service No Ready Endpoints
alerts.description: Critical: Service has no ready endpoints — all pods are failing health checks. Check pod readiness and deployment status.

alerts.name: node_critical_cpu_utilization
alerts.title: Node Critical Cpu Utilization
alerts.description: Critical: Node CPU utilization exceeds 90%. Immediate investigation and capacity planning required.

alerts.name: node_critical_disk_usage
alerts.title: Node Critical Disk Usage
alerts.description: Critical: Node filesystem usage exceeds 90%. Immediate action required to prevent disk exhaustion.

alerts.name: node_critical_memory_usage
alerts.title: Node Critical Memory Usage
alerts.description: Critical: Node memory utilization exceeds 95%, high risk of OOM kills and pod evictions.

alerts.name: node_disk_pressure
alerts.title: Node Disk Pressure
alerts.description: Warning: Node DiskPressure condition sustained for 10+ continuous minutes. Uses min_over_time to filter transient kubelet flag toggling. Also check actual disk usage with node_critical_disk_usage.

alerts.name: node_high_cpu_utilization
alerts.title: Node High Cpu Utilization
alerts.description: Warning: Node CPU utilization exceeds 80% for 5 minutes. Scale workloads or add nodes.

alerts.name: node_high_disk_usage
alerts.title: Node High Disk Usage
alerts.description: Warning: Node filesystem usage exceeds 80%. Clean up or expand disk capacity.

alerts.name: node_high_memory_usage
alerts.title: Node High Memory Usage
alerts.description: Warning: Node memory utilization exceeds 85%, approaching OOM conditions. Review memory-intensive workloads.

alerts.name: node_memory_pressure
alerts.title: Node Memory Pressure
alerts.description: Warning: Node MemoryPressure condition sustained for 10+ continuous minutes. Uses min_over_time to filter transient kubelet flag toggling. Also check actual memory utilization with node_critical_memory_usage.

alerts.name: node_not_ready
alerts.title: Node Not Ready
alerts.description: Critical: Node has been in NotReady state continuously for 5+ minutes. Uses min_over_time to filter out node churn during scale-in/termination.

alerts.name: node_unschedulable
alerts.title: Node Unschedulable
alerts.description: Warning: Node is marked unschedulable (cordoned) for >5 minutes.

alerts.name: kube_state_metrics_stale_data
alerts.title: Kube State Metrics Stale Data
alerts.description: Info: kube-state-metrics reports PVs in Failed/Released state that don't exist in the actual cluster. Stale time series from previously deleted resources. Restart kube-state-metrics to flush. Runs every 60min with 24h silence.

alerts.name: pod_crashloop_backoff
alerts.title: Pod Crashloop Backoff
alerts.description: Critical: Container is in CrashLoopBackOff state. Check pod logs, resource limits, and application configuration.

alerts.name: pod_evicted
alerts.title: Pod Evicted
alerts.description: Warning: Pod was evicted from node due to resource pressure. Review node resource usage and pod resource requests.

alerts.name: pod_failed_state
alerts.title: Pod Failed State
alerts.description: Critical: Pod has entered Failed state. Excludes trivy-system (scan pods), kube-system (system pods) which normally show transient Failed state during completion.

alerts.name: pod_high_restart_rate
alerts.title: Pod High Restart Rate
alerts.description: Warning: Pod has restarted 10+ times in 15 minutes indicating instability. Investigate pod logs and application health.

alerts.name: pod_image_pull_backoff
alerts.title: Pod Image Pull Backoff
alerts.description: Warning: Pod cannot pull container image. Verify image name, registry access, and credentials.

alerts.name: pod_oom_killed
alerts.title: Pod Oom Killed
alerts.description: Critical: Container was OOMKilled. Increase memory limits or investigate memory leak.

alerts.name: pod_pending_too_long
alerts.title: Pod Pending Too Long
alerts.description: Warning: Pod has been in Pending state for >5 minutes. Check resource requests, node capacity, and affinity rules. Note: trivy-system excluded (scan pods legitimately queue).

alerts.name: container_cpu_over_provisioned
alerts.title: Container Cpu Over Provisioned
alerts.description: Info: Pod is using less than 10% of its requested CPU over 1 hour. Right-size CPU requests to improve scheduling efficiency.

alerts.name: container_memory_over_provisioned
alerts.title: Container Memory Over Provisioned
alerts.description: Info: Pod is using less than 10% of its requested memory over 1 hour. Right-size memory requests to free up scheduling capacity.

alerts.name: container_resource_under_requested
alerts.title: Container Resource Under Requested
alerts.description: Warning: Pod CPU usage consistently exceeds 95% of its request. Increase CPU request to avoid throttling and poor scheduling decisions.

alerts.name: node_low_utilization
alerts.title: Node Low Utilization
alerts.description: Info: Node CPU utilization below 10% for 1 hour. Consider node consolidation to reduce infrastructure costs.

alerts.name: pods_without_resource_requests
alerts.title: Pods Without Resource Requests
alerts.description: Warning: Container running without resource requests. Affects scheduler decisions and cluster stability. Define CPU and memory requests.

alerts.name: image_from_untrusted_registry
alerts.title: Image From Untrusted Registry
alerts.description: Warning: Container image pulled from non-standard registry. Review image source and update image pull policies. Customize trusted registries in the alert query.

alerts.name: namespace_without_network_policy
alerts.title: Namespace Without Network Policy
alerts.description: Warning: Active namespace has no NetworkPolicy configured. Unrestricted pod-to-pod communication. Implement network segmentation.

alerts.name: pod_missing_resource_limits
alerts.title: Pod Missing Resource Limits
alerts.description: Warning: Container running without memory limits. Risk of OOMKill and noisy-neighbour issues. Define resource limits.

alerts.name: unauthorized_api_access_high
alerts.title: Unauthorized Api Access High
alerts.description: Critical: High rate of 401/403 API responses. Potential unauthorized access or misconfigured RBAC. Review audit logs.

alerts.name: pv_available_unused
alerts.title: Pv Available Unused
alerts.description: Info: PersistentVolume has been Available (unclaimed) for >1 hour. Disk is provisioned and costing money but no PVC is using it. Delete if not needed.

alerts.name: pv_failed
alerts.title: Pv Failed
alerts.description: Critical: PersistentVolume is in Failed state. Data access issues likely. Check storage backend and PV configuration.

alerts.name: pv_released_orphaned
alerts.title: Pv Released Orphaned
alerts.description: Warning: PersistentVolume in Released state for >30 minutes. The PVC was deleted but the underlying disk (EBS/Azure Disk) still exists and is incurring storage costs. Delete the PV or set reclaimPolicy: Delete to clean up.

alerts.name: pv_usage_high
alerts.title: Pv Usage High
alerts.description: Warning: PersistentVolume usage exceeds 85%. Expand volume or clean up data to prevent pod failures.

alerts.name: pvc_bound_no_pod_attached
alerts.title: Pvc Bound No Pod Attached
alerts.description: Info: PVC has been Bound (disk provisioned) but not attached to any running pod for more than 24 hours. Common causes: StatefulSet scaled to 0, deployment deleted without PVC cleanup, or orphaned dev volume. Review and delete if no longer needed to reduce storage costs.

alerts.name: pvc_lost
alerts.title: Pvc Lost
alerts.description: Critical: PVC is in Lost state — backing PV no longer exists. Immediate investigation required to prevent data loss.

alerts.name: pvc_pending
alerts.title: Pvc Pending
alerts.description: Warning: PVC has been in Pending state for >5 minutes. Check PV availability and StorageClass configuration.

alerts.name: storage_volume_under_utilized
alerts.title: Storage Volume Under Utilized
alerts.description: Info: PersistentVolume is less than 20% utilized. Consider downsizing the volume to reduce storage costs.

alerts.name: cronjob_job_stuck_running
alerts.title: Cronjob Job Stuck Running
alerts.description: Warning: CronJob has an active job running for more than 2 hours. The job may be stuck or hanging. Check pod logs and consider setting activeDeadlineSeconds on the job spec to auto-terminate long-running jobs.

alerts.name: cronjob_missed_schedule
alerts.title: Cronjob Missed Schedule
alerts.description: Warning: CronJob has missed its scheduled execution by >5 minutes. Multiplied by (next_schedule_time > 0) to exclude KSM setting metric to 0 during active job execution — avoids false positives when job is currently running.

alerts.name: cronjob_suspended
alerts.title: Cronjob Suspended
alerts.description: Warning: CronJob has been suspended (spec.suspend=true) for more than 1 hour. If this was intentional for maintenance, re-enable it when done. Suspended CronJobs will miss their schedules silently.

alerts.name: daemonset_pods_not_scheduled
alerts.title: Daemonset Pods Not Scheduled
alerts.description: Warning: DaemonSet is missing pods on some nodes for a sustained 15-minute window. Compares min desired vs max ready over the window so node autoscaling churn (new nodes whose pods are still starting) does not fire the alert.

alerts.name: deployment_replica_mismatch
alerts.title: Deployment Replica Mismatch
alerts.description: Warning: Deployment has fewer available replicas than desired for a sustained 15-minute window. Compares min desired vs max available over the window so rolling updates and HPA scale-ups do not fire the alert.

alerts.name: hpa_at_max_replicas
alerts.title: Hpa At Max Replicas
alerts.description: Warning: HPA has reached maximum replicas. Workload may still be under pressure. Review max replica limit and application load.

alerts.name: hpa_unable_to_scale
alerts.title: Hpa Unable To Scale
alerts.description: Warning: HPA is unable to scale workload. Check metrics server and HPA configuration.

alerts.name: job_backoff_limit_exceeded_events
alerts.title: Job Backoff Limit Exceeded Events
alerts.description: Warning: Job has exceeded its backoff retry limit and will not be retried. Check job logs for root cause.

alerts.name: job_failed
alerts.title: Job Failed
alerts.description: Warning: Kubernetes Job has failed. Check job logs and pod events.

alerts.name: statefulset_replica_mismatch
alerts.title: Statefulset Replica Mismatch
alerts.description: Warning: StatefulSet has fewer ready replicas than desired for a sustained 15-minute window. Compares min desired vs max ready over the window so rolling updates, scale-ups, and node drains do not fire the alert.

alerts.name: memory_table_overflow_error
alerts.title: Memory Table Overflow Error
alerts.description: Critical: MemoryTableOverflowError detected in logs. Investigate memory pressure on the affected node/pod.
